arguments.statement: 2026-11-04 14:16 的 registry 记录说 edge-2026.11.4 上传尝试被拒绝，原因是 checksum mismatch；镜像未发布，tag 未创建，registry 中没有对应 digest。这不是上传成功，也不能当作门店可以开始测试的依据。

decision_rationale: The registry record explicitly says the upload was rejected and the image was not published. Keep that boundary before telling the user not to notify stores.
